payload.outcome: Fixed in PR #2888 (merged 2026-09-18). The catalogue is now sliced SERVER-side before anything crosses the RSC boundary, following the review-state-page precedent whose own comment records why the obvious alternative failed — client-side slicing after the full array has already crossed does not reduce the transferred payload. Filtering, sorting and facets stay whole-catalogue on the server; only the 50-entry page reaches the client component, and the page resets on a filter or query clear. The route now carries a required serverPages ceiling in bundle-budget.json, so the size cannot silently return; the reviewer confirmed the route-group path resolution for that entry.
